l-m-m2-b03-39.material: A chọtara probability inweta opekata mpe otu 6 mgbe a tụbara dice ugboro abụọ otu a. ①Buru ụzọ chọta probability enweghị 6 ma ọlị ②Probability enweghị 6 n'otu ntụtụ bụ 5/6 ③Probability enweghị 6 na ntụtụ abụọ bụ 5/6×5/6=25/36 ④Probability opekata mpe otu 6 bụ 1/6+1/6=1/3
l-m-m2-b03-39.s.s1.r.a: Atụmatụ ịchọta ihe megidere ya mbụ ziri ezi.
l-m-m2-b03-39.s.s1.r.b: Ihu 5 abụghị 6, ya mere ọ bụ 5/6.
l-m-m2-b03-39.s.s1.r.c: A na-amụba ntụtụ abụọ ọnụ iji nweta 25/36, ya mere nke a ziri ezi.
l-m-m2-b03-39.s.s1.explain: Maka “opekata mpe otu ugboro,” wepụ probability ọ gaghị eme ma ọlị na 1. 1−25/36=11/36.
l-m-m2-b03-39.s.s2.model.0: Na ④, ejighị atụmatụ ①, tinyekwara 1/6. 1−25/36=11/36 ziri ezi, 1/3=12/36 dị iche, ya mere ezighị ezi.
l-m-m2-b03-39.s.s2.model.1: Ọnọdụ 6 pụtara ugboro abụọ na-agbakọta, ya mere etinyela ha ọnụ. Iwepụ 25/36 na 1 na-enye 11/36.

l-m-m2-b04-05.material: A chọtara ahịrị gafere (2, 5) na (4, 11) otu a. ① Slope (11−5)÷(4−2)=3 ② Tinye (2, 5) n’ime y=3x+b: 5=6+b ③ b=5+6=11 ④ y=3x+11

l-m-m2-b04-13.goal: Soro ngwọta ahaghị nhata −2x+3>9, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara ihe ji eme, site na nzọụkwụ ruo na nzọụkwụ; chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ njehie mere.
l-m-m2-b04-13.material: Otu onye doziri −2x+3>9. ① Bugharịa 3 n'akụkụ nke ọzọ: −2x>9−3 ② −2x>6 ③ Kekọrịta akụkụ abụọ ahụ na −2: x>−3 ④ Ya mere x=−2 bụkwa ngwọta.
l-m-m2-b04-13.s.s1.r.a: Ide 9−3 mgbe e bugharịrị 3 ziri ezi.
l-m-m2-b04-13.s.s1.r.d: ④ bụ nsonaazụ sitere n'ịtụkwasị ③ obi. Ọ bụghị ebe njehie mbụ dị.
l-m-m2-b04-13.s.s1.explain: Ikekọrịta na ọnụọgụ na-adịghị mma na-atụgharị akara ahaghị nhata, ya mere x<−3. x=−2 abụghị ngwọta.
l-m-m2-b04-13.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe a na-ekekọrịta na ọnụọgụ na-adịghị mma −2, a ga-atụgharị ụzọ akara ahaghị nhata, ya mere ③ ezighị ezi, azịza ya bụ x<−3.
l-m-m2-b04-13.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe etinyere x=−2, −2×(−2)+3=7, nke pere mpe karịa 9, ya mere ọ bụghị ngwọta; njehie ahụ dị na ③.

l-m-m2-b04-21.goal: Soro ngwọta x+2y=7, 2x+y=8, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, chọta ebe mbụ hiere ụzọ ma dozie ya.
l-m-m2-b04-21.material: Onye doziri x+2y=7, 2x+y=8. ① Mụbaa nhatanha mbụ na 2: 2x+4y=14 ② Wepụ nhatanha abụọ n'akụkụ ibe: 3y=14+8=22 ③ y=22/3 ④ Tinye uru a ka ịchọta x.
l-m-m2-b04-21.s.s1.r.a: 2x+4y=14, sitere n'ịmụba nhatanha mbụ na 2, ziri ezi.

l-m-m2-b04-21.s.s2.model.0: Ị wepụrụ n'akụkụ ibe, ya mere akụkụ aka nri kwesịrị ịbụ 14−8=6, ma agbakwunyere ya, ya mere ② ezighị ezi.

l-m-m2-b05-24.material: Triangle ABC nwere AB=AC na ∠A=40°. ① Ebe AB=AC, ∠A=∠B ② ∠B=40° ③ ∠C=180°−40°−40°=100° ④ ∠C=100°
l-m-m2-b05-24.s.s1.r.b: ② bụ uru sitere na ①, ọ bụghị njehie mbụ.
l-m-m2-b05-24.s.s1.r.c: ③ bụ ngụkọta ji ② mee ihe, ya mere ọ bụghị njehie mbụ.

l-m-m2-b05-24.s.s1.explain: Akụkụ ndị chere ihu n’akụkụ hà nhata AB na AC bụ ∠C na ∠B. ∠B=∠C=(180°−40°)÷2=70°.
l-m-m2-b05-24.s.s2.model.0: Akụkụ ndị chere ihu n’akụkụ hà nhata hà nhata; ya mere ∠B=∠C kwesịrị ịdị. Ma ① kwuru ∠A=∠B, nke ezighi ezi.
l-m-m2-b05-24.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ AB=AC, mgbe ahụ ∠B=∠C, nchikọta ha bụ 140°, nke ọ bụla bụ 70°; mana ① mehiere site na mmalite.

l-m-m2-b05-25.title: Slope e si n’isi abụọ nweta: njehie dị aṅaa?
l-m-m2-b05-25.goal: Soro ngwọta ahịrị na-agafe (0, 4) na (2, 0), chọta ma dozie njehie mbụ.
l-m-m2-b05-25.material: Chọta ahịrị na-agafe (0, 4) na (2, 0). ① Slope=(mmụba x)÷(mmụba y)=2÷(−4) ② =−1/2 ③ b=4 ④ y=−x/2+4
l-m-m2-b05-25.s.s1.r.b: 2÷(−4)=−1/2 bụ ngụkọta ziri ezi maka ①.
l-m-m2-b05-25.s.s1.r.c: Site na (0, 4), achọtara b=4 nke ọma.
l-m-m2-b05-25.s.s1.r.d: ④ bụ nsonaazụ sitere na usoro ndị gara aga.
l-m-m2-b05-25.s.s1.explain: Slope bụ (mmụba y)÷(mmụba x)=−4÷2=−2. Ahịrị bụ y=−2x+4.
l-m-m2-b05-25.s.s2.model.0: Slope bụ mmụba y÷mmụba x; ya mere −4÷2=−2, mana ① kewara n’ụzọ megidere.
l-m-m2-b05-25.s.s2.model.1: Itinye (2, 0) na y=−x/2+4 na-enye 3; ahịrị ahụ anaghị agafe isi ahụ, ya mere ① ezighi ezi.

l-m-m2-b0s5-07.title: Ebee ka ngwọta probability rock-paper-scissors hiere?
l-m-m2-b0s5-07.goal: Soro ngwọta ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ ịchọta probability A ga-emeri rock-paper-scissors, chọta ebe mbụ hiere ụzọ ma dozie ya.
l-m-m2-b0s5-07.material: A na B na-egwu rock-paper-scissors otu ugboro. Nke a bụ ngwọta probability A ga-emeri. (1) Ụzọ ha abụọ ga-egwu: 3×3=9. (2) Ọnọdụ tie: 3. (3) Ọnọdụ nwere onye mmeri: 9+3=12. (4) A na-emeri ọkara n'ime ha, ụzọ 6, ya mere probability 6/9=2/3.
l-m-m2-b0s5-07.s.s1.r.a: Onye ọ bụla nwere ike igosi ihe 3, ya mere 9 ziri ezi.
l-m-m2-b0s5-07.s.s1.r.b: Ọnọdụ 3 ebe ha abụọ gosiri otu ihe ziri ezi.
l-m-m2-b0s5-07.s.s1.o.c: (3) Ịgụ ọnọdụ nwere onye mmeri dịka 12
l-m-m2-b0s5-07.s.s1.o.d: (4) Iwere ọkara ọnọdụ dịka mmeri A
l-m-m2-b0s5-07.s.s1.r.d: Echiche na A na-emeri ọkara n'ime ọnọdụ nwere mmeri ziri ezi.
l-m-m2-b0s5-07.s.s1.explain: Ọnọdụ nwere mmeri bụ 9−3=6. A na-emeri ọkara n'ime ha, ụzọ 3, ya mere probability 3/9=1/3.
l-m-m2-b0s5-07.s.s2.model.0: Na (3) e kwuru 9+3=12, ma ọnọdụ mmeri bụ ngụkọta wepụ tie, ya bụ 9−3=6. Mgbe e doziri ya, 3/9=1/3.
l-m-m2-b0s5-07.s.s2.model.1: Ọnọdụ na-abụghị tie bụ ngụkọta 9 wepụ tie 3, ya mere (3) ezighị ezi. Ọkara nke 6 bụ ụzọ 3, probability 1/3.

l-m-m2-b01-14.title: Ịtụgharị ahịrịokwu ka ọ bụrụ inequality
l-m-m2-b01-14.goal: Gbanwee “3 ugboro otu nọmba wepụ 4 dịkarịa ala 11” ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (okwu, tebụl, eserese, ma ọ bụ okwu), kọwaa ihe mere ọ pụtara otu ihe.
l-m-m2-b01-14.material: Ahịrịokwu: 3 ugboro nọmba x wepụ 4 dịkarịa ala 11. Dee ahịrịokwu a dịka inequality.
l-m-m2-b01-14.s.s1.prompt: Kedu inequality pụtara otu ihe na ahịrịokwu ahụ?
l-m-m2-b01-14.s.s1.r.b: Parentheses pụtara iwepụ 4 mbụ, mesịa mụbaa na 3.
l-m-m2-b01-14.s.s1.r.c: “Dịkarịa ala” gụnyere ikpe nhata, ya mere jiri ≥.
l-m-m2-b01-14.s.s1.r.d: ≤ pụtara “karịa karịa ma ọ bụ hà nhata kacha”. “Dịkarịa ala” bụ ≥.
l-m-m2-b01-14.s.s1.explain: 3 ugboro x bụ 3x, iwepụ 4 na-enye 3x−4. “Dịkarịa ala 11” pụtara nhata ma ọ bụ karịa 11, ya mere jiri ≥.
l-m-m2-b01-14.s.s2.model.0: 3 ugboro bụ 3x, iwepụ 4 bụ 3x−4. Ebe ọ bụ opekata mpe 11, jiri ≥ dị ka akara inequality.
l-m-m2-b01-14.s.s2.model.1: “Dịkarịa ala 11” pụtara nọmba hà nhata ma ọ bụ karịa 11, ya mere jiri ≥. Iwepụ 4 na 3x n'enweghị parentheses na-enye 3x−4≥11.

l-m-m2-b01-18.title: Kedu ka anyị si akọwa ngwọta simultaneous equations site na graphs?
l-m-m2-b01-18.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ka anyị si akọwa ngwọta simultaneous equations site na graphs?
l-m-m2-b01-18.goal: Gbanwee ngwọta simultaneous equations x+y=6, x−y=2 gaa n'ụdị ọzọ (okwu, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-m2-b01-18.material: Ka anyị nwaa ịkọwa ngwọta simultaneous equations x+y=6, x−y=2 site na graphs nke linear functions abụọ y=−x+6 na y=x−2.
l-m-m2-b01-18.s.s1.r.a: Ọdịiche dị n'etiti y-intercepts 6 na −2 enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ngwọta.
l-m-m2-b01-18.s.s1.r.b: Slopes bụ −1 na 1, ngụkọta bụ 0. Nke ahụ abụghị ngwọta.
l-m-m2-b01-18.s.s1.o.c: Coordinates nke isi ebe graphs abụọ ahụ zutere
l-m-m2-b01-18.s.s1.r.d: x-intercept bụ uru maka otu ahịrị naanị, ya mere ọ bụghị ngwọta.
l-m-m2-b01-18.s.s1.explain: Ngwọta bụ (x, y) na-emezu nhatanha abụọ ahụ. Graph abụọ ahụ zutere na (4, 2), nke a bụkwa ngwọta.
l-m-m2-b01-18.s.s2.model.0: Enwere ike ịgbanwe x+y=6 ka ọ bụrụ y=−x+6, x−y=2 bụrụ y=x−2. Ngwọta na-emezu nhatanha abụọ, ya mere ọ bụ isi ebe graphs abụọ ahụ zutere.
l-m-m2-b01-18.s.s2.model.1: Isi dị na graph ọ bụla bụ (x,y) na-emezu nhatanha ahụ. Naanị isi na-emezu ha abụọ n'otu oge bụ ebe ha zutere, ya mere ngwọta bụ coordinates nke intersection.

l-m-m2-b01-22.goal: Gbanwee ahịrị nwere intercepts abụọ e nyere gaa n'ụdị ọzọ (okwu, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere ọ pụtara otu ihe.
l-m-m2-b01-22.material: Ahịrị na-ezute x-axis na (3, 0), y-axis na (0, −6). Dee ahịrị a dịka linear function y=ax+b.
l-m-m2-b01-22.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụrụ na i tinye x=3, y=3, ya mere ọ naghị agafe (3, 0).
l-m-m2-b01-22.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ na i tinye x=3, y=−4.5, ya mere ọ naghị agafe (3, 0).

l-m-m2-b01-22.s.s1.explain: y-intercept bụ −6, ọ na-agafe (3, 0), ya mere site na 0=3a−6, a=2. Ya mere y=2x−6.

l-m-m2-b01-22.s.s2.model.1: Slope bụ (mmụba y)÷(mmụba x)=6÷3=2, y-intercept bụ −6, ya mere y=2x−6.

l-m-m2-b01-26.title: Ikwughachi angle bisector vertex site na base
l-m-m2-b01-26.goal: Gbanwee angle bisector nke apex ka ụdị ọzọ (expression, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu.
l-m-m2-b01-26.material: Na triangle ABC, AB=AC, D bụ ebe bisector ∠A zutere BC. Kwuo ihe anyị maara gbasara AD site na base BC.
l-m-m2-b01-26.s.s1.o.a: AD nwere ogologo otu na AB
l-m-m2-b01-26.s.s1.r.a: Enweghị ike ikwu AD hà nhata AB.
l-m-m2-b01-26.s.s1.o.b: Ogologo AD na BC hà nhata
l-m-m2-b01-26.s.s1.r.b: Enweghị ike ikwu AD na BC nwere otu ogologo.
l-m-m2-b01-26.s.s1.r.c: AD na-ezute BC na D; ya mere ọ bụghị parallel.
l-m-m2-b01-26.s.s1.o.d: AD bụ perpendicular bisector nke BC
l-m-m2-b01-26.s.s1.explain: Na isosceles triangle, bisector apex angle na-ekewa base ka ọ bụrụ halves perpendicular.
l-m-m2-b01-26.s.s2.model.0: △ABD na △ACD congruent; ya mere BD=CD, ∠ADB=∠ADC=90°, AD bụ perpendicular bisector BC.
l-m-m2-b01-26.s.s2.model.1: Isosceles triangle nwere otu ọdịdị n’akụkụ abụọ nke apex bisector; AD na-ekewa base n’etiti perpendicular.

l-m-m2-b02-02.title: Ịhazigharị usoro mpaghara trapezoid ka ọ bụrụ expression ịdị elu h
l-m-m2-b02-02.goal: Gbanwee S=(a+b)h/2 gaa n’ụdị ọzọ ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-m2-b02-02.material: Mpaghara trapezoid bụ S=(a+b)×h÷2. Hazigharịa usoro a ka o nye ịdị elu h.
l-m-m2-b02-02.s.s1.prompt: Kedu expression e doziri maka h?
l-m-m2-b02-02.s.s1.r.a: Ị ga-amụba akụkụ abụọ na 2, mana nke a kewara na 2 kama.
l-m-m2-b02-02.s.s1.r.b: (a+b) na h ka a mụbara, ya mere kewaa na ya, egbula ya.
l-m-m2-b02-02.s.s1.r.d: E tinyere numerator na denominator n’akụkụ na-ezighi ezi. Ọ naghị arụ ọrụ ma tinye ya na S=(a+b)h/2.
l-m-m2-b02-02.s.s1.explain: Ịmụba akụkụ abụọ na 2 na-enye 2S=(a+b)h; ikewa akụkụ abụọ na (a+b) na-enye h=2S/(a+b).
l-m-m2-b02-02.s.s2.model.0: Mụbaa akụkụ abụọ na 2 iji nweta 2S=(a+b)h, kewaa na (a+b); ya mere h=2S/(a+b).
l-m-m2-b02-02.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ a=2, b=4, h=3, S=9; 2S/(a+b)=18/6=3, nke hà nhata h; ya mere expression abụọ ahụ bụ otu.

l-m-m2-b02-06.topic: Site na fraction gaa na decimal na-emegharị
l-m-m2-b02-06.goal: Gbanwee 2/15 ka ọ bụrụ decimal n’ụdị ọzọ, kọwakwa ihe mere o ji nwee otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-m-m2-b02-06.material: Ịgbakọ 2/15=2÷15 na-enye 0.1333…. 1 dị n’ọnọdụ mbụ pụtara naanị otu ugboro, 3 na-emegharị site n’ọnọdụ nke abụọ gaa n’ihu. Tinye ntụpọ n’elu akụkụ na-emegharị iji dee ya nkenke.
l-m-m2-b02-06.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ụzọ ziri ezi isi dee 2/15 site n’akara ntụpọ?

l-m-m2-b02-30.title: Njirimara diagonal nke quadrilateral nwere akụkụ anọ hà nhata
l-m-m2-b02-30.goal: Gbanwee quadrilateral nke akụkụ anọ niile nwere otu ogologo gaa n'ụdị okwu ọzọ (nhatanha, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere ọ pụtara otu ihe.
l-m-m2-b02-30.material: E nwere quadrilateral ABCD nke akụkụ anọ ya niile nwere otu ogologo. Jiri okwu kwuo njirimara diagonal nke si n'eziokwu a pụta.
l-m-m2-b02-30.s.s1.o.a: Diagonal abụọ ahụ nwere otu ogologo
l-m-m2-b02-30.s.s1.r.a: Ịha diagonal hà nhata bụ njirimara rectangle. Rhombus dị iche.
l-m-m2-b02-30.s.s1.o.b: Diagonal abụọ ahụ na-ezute n’akụkụ ziri ezi ma na-ekewa ibe ha ụzọ hà nhata.
l-m-m2-b02-30.s.s1.o.c: Diagonal abụọ ahụ na-agakọ ọnụ mgbe niile.
l-m-m2-b02-30.s.s1.r.c: Diagonal abụọ ahụ na-ezute n’otu ebe, ya mere ha anaghị agakọ ọnụ.
l-m-m2-b02-30.s.s1.r.d: N’ime quadrilateral a, diagonal abụọ ahụ dị n’ime ya.
l-m-m2-b02-30.s.s1.explain: Quadrilateral nwere akụkụ anọ hà nhata bụ rhombus. Diagonal abụọ nke rhombus na-ezute n’akụkụ ziri ezi ma na-ekewa ibe ha ụzọ hà nhata.
l-m-m2-b02-30.s.s2.model.0: Quadrilateral nwere akụkụ anọ hà nhata bụ rhombus, diagonal ya na-ezutekwa n’akụkụ ziri ezi ma na-ekewa ibe ha ụzọ hà nhata; ya mere nke a bụ otu njirimara ahụ.
l-m-m2-b02-30.s.s2.model.1: Diagonal hà nhata bụ nke rectangle, diagonal ya anaghịkwa agakọ ọnụ; ya mere naanị njirimara nke izute n’akụkụ ziri ezi na ikewa ibe ha hà nhata dabara rhombus.

l-m-m2-b02-38.topic: Ohere nke ihe omume na-abụghị nke a chọrọ
l-m-m2-b02-38.goal: Gbanwee “opekata mpe otu bụ heads” gaa n’ụdị ọzọ (nhata, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwakwa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-m2-b02-38.material: Tụba mkpụrụ ego 2 n’otu oge. Anyị chọrọ ịchọta ohere ihe omume “opekata mpe otu gosiri heads” n’ụzọ ọzọ.
l-m-m2-b02-38.s.s1.prompt: Olee okwu ngụkọta ga-achọta otu ohere ahụ?
l-m-m2-b02-38.s.s1.r.a: 1/2×2=1, nke dị iche na ohere n’ezie bụ 3/4.
l-m-m2-b02-38.s.s1.r.b: Nchikọta ya bụ 1, nke dị iche na ohere n’ezie bụ 3/4.
l-m-m2-b02-38.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ uru a na-enweta site n’ịgụ naanị otu ikpe, 1/4.
l-m-m2-b02-38.s.s1.explain: Ihe megidere “opekata mpe otu bụ heads” bụ “ha abụọ bụ tails”. 1−1/4=3/4.
l-m-m2-b02-38.s.s2.model.0: Ihe megidere “opekata mpe otu bụ heads” bụ “ha abụọ bụ tails”; ya mere wepụ ohere ahụ na 1. 1−1/4=3/4.
l-m-m2-b02-38.s.s2.model.1: N’ime nsonaazụ 4 nwere ike ime, naanị 1 ebe ha abụọ bụ tails ka a ga-ewepụ; ya mere ịchọta ya dịka 1−1/4 na-enye otu uru ahụ.

l-m-m2-b03-18.title: Igosipụta ọnọdụ rectangle dịka usoro nhatanha
l-m-m2-b03-18.goal: Degharịa ogologo na obosara rectangle n'ụdị ọzọ (nhatanha, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere ọ pụtara otu ihe.
l-m-m2-b03-18.material: Ka ogologo rectangle bụrụ x cm, obosara bụrụ y cm. Perimeter bụ 30 cm, ogologo dị mkpụmkpụ 3 cm karịa okpukpu 2 nke obosara. Gosipụta ọnọdụ ndị a dịka usoro nhatanha.
l-m-m2-b03-18.s.s1.r.a: Perimeter bụ okpukpu 2 nke (ogologo+obosara), ma e dere ọkara naanị.
l-m-m2-b03-18.s.s1.r.b: “Dị mkpụmkpụ 3 cm” gbanwere ka ọ bụrụ “dị ogologo.”
l-m-m2-b03-18.s.s1.r.c: A gbanwere ọrụ ogologo na obosara.
l-m-m2-b03-18.s.s1.explain: Perimeter bụ 2x+2y. Ogologo dị mkpụmkpụ 3 karịa okpukpu 2 nke obosara, ya mere x=2y−3. x=9, y=6 dabara kwa.
l-m-m2-b03-18.s.s2.model.0: Perimeter bụ 2(x+y), ya mere 2x+2y=30. Ogologo bụ okpukpu 2 nke obosara wepụ 3, ya mere x=2y−3.
l-m-m2-b03-18.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ x=9, y=6, perimeter bụ 30, 2×6−3=9 hà nhata ogologo, ya mere nhatanha ndị a dabara n'ahịrịokwu ahụ.

l-m-m2-b03-24.title: Iji isi abụọ kọwaa y=−2x+4
l-m-m2-b03-24.topic: Site na Equation gaa n'asụsụ Graph
l-m-m2-b03-24.goal: Degharịa graph linear function y=−2x+4 n'ụdị ọzọ (nhatanha, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere ọ pụtara otu ihe.
l-m-m2-b03-24.material: N'ebughị graph linear function y=−2x+4, kọwaa ya site n'isi abụọ ọ na-agafe.
l-m-m2-b03-24.s.s1.r.a: y-intercept bụ 4, slope bụ −2. Ị gbanwere nọmba abụọ ahụ.
l-m-m2-b03-24.s.s1.r.b: Mgbe x=0, y=4, ya mere ọ naghị agafe origin.
l-m-m2-b03-24.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụrụ y=0, −2x+4=0 na-enye x=2. x-intercept abụghị −2.
l-m-m2-b03-24.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ x=0, y=4; ọ bụrụ y=0, x=2. Ya mere ọ na-agafe (0, 4) na (2, 0).
l-m-m2-b03-24.s.s2.model.0: Itinye x=0 na-enye y=4, itinye y=0 na-enye −2x+4=0, ya mere x=2. Ọ na-agafe (0, 4) na (2, 0).
l-m-m2-b03-24.s.s2.model.1: y-intercept bụ 4, ya mere ọ na-agafe (0, 4); slope bụ negative, ya mere n'aka nri ọ na-ezute x-axis na (2, 0).

l-m-m2-b03-30.title: Ikwughachi Njirimara Diagonals dịka Njirimara Akụkụ
l-m-m2-b03-30.goal: Degharịa quadrilateral diagonals abụọ ya na-ekewa ibe ha ụzọ abụọ gaa n'ụdị ọzọ (equation, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere ọ pụtara otu ihe.
l-m-m2-b03-30.material: E nwere quadrilateral diagonal abụọ ya na-ekewa ibe ha ụzọ abụọ. Jiri okwu kwughachi njirimara akụkụ nke si n'eziokwu a pụta.
l-m-m2-b03-30.s.s1.prompt: Kedu njirimara akụkụ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile?
l-m-m2-b03-30.s.s1.o.a: Akụkụ anọ niile hà nhata ogologo
l-m-m2-b03-30.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ rhombus. Ịkewa diagonal naanị apụtaghị akụkụ anọ niile hà nhata.
l-m-m2-b03-30.s.s1.o.b: Angles anọ niile bụ right angles
l-m-m2-b03-30.s.s1.r.b: Nke ahụ bụ ọnọdụ rectangle. Ị pụghị ịmata nke a site n'ịkewa naanị.
l-m-m2-b03-30.s.s1.r.c: Ị pụghị ịmata ọnọdụ right-angle site n'ịkewa naanị.
l-m-m2-b03-30.s.s1.o.d: Ụzọ abụọ nke akụkụ ndị na-eche ibe ha ihu ọ bụla bụ parallel
l-m-m2-b03-30.s.s1.explain: Quadrilateral nke diagonals abụọ ya na-ekewa ibe ha ụzọ abụọ bụ parallelogram. N'ime parallelogram, ụzọ abụọ nke akụkụ ndị na-eche ibe ha ihu bụ parallel.
l-m-m2-b03-30.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ diagonal na-ekewa ibe ha, ọ bụ parallelogram nke akụkụ na-abụghị ibe hà nhata ogologo ma parallel, ya mere ụzọ abụọ ndị na-abụghị ibe ha bụ parallel.
l-m-m2-b03-30.s.s2.model.1: Ịkewa naanị anaghị egosi akụkụ anọ niile hà nhata ma ọ bụ right angles, ya mere naanị nkwupụta na akụkụ ndị na-eche ibe ha ihu bụ parallel bụ eziokwu mgbe niile.

l-m-m2-b04-06.title: Kedu nhatanha dabara na tebụl?
l-m-m2-b04-06.topic: Ịtụgharị Tebụl ka ọ bụrụ Nhatanha
l-m-m2-b04-06.goal: Gbanwee tebụl ọnụọgụ akwụkwọ ndetu na ọnụahịa niile gaa n'ụdị ọzọ (nhatanha, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere ọ pụtara otu ihe.
l-m-m2-b04-06.material: Nke a bụ tebụl ọnụahịa niile y (na narị won) a kwụrụ maka akwụkwọ ndetu x. Mgbe x=1, y=5; x=2, 7; x=3, 9; x=4, 11. Gosipụta tebụl a dịka nhatanha.
l-m-m2-b04-06.s.s1.r.a: x=1 na-enye 5, ziri ezi, ma x=2 na-enye 8, nke adabaghị na tebụl.
l-m-m2-b04-06.s.s1.r.b: x=1 na-enye 5 ziri ezi, ma x=2 na-enye 6, dị iche na tebụl.
l-m-m2-b04-06.s.s1.r.c: x=1 na-enye 5 ziri ezi, ma x=2 na-enye 10, adabaghị na tebụl.
l-m-m2-b04-06.s.s1.explain: Mgbe x na-abawanye 1, y na-abawanye 2, y=5 mgbe x=1, ya mere y=2x+3.
l-m-m2-b04-06.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe x na-abawanye 1, y na-abawanye 2, ọ bụ 5 na x=1, ya mere y=2x+3.
l-m-m2-b04-06.s.s2.model.1: Itinye x=3 na-enye 2×3+3=9, otu ihe na tebụl, ya mere ha pụtara otu ihe.

l-m-m2-b04-14.title: Kedu ka ị ga-esi dee 0.1212… dịka irighiri ọnụọgụ?
l-m-m2-b04-14.goal: Gbanwee ọnụọgụ ntụpọ na-emegharị 0.1212… ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (nhatanha, tebụl, eserese, ma ọ bụ okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-m2-b04-14.material: 0.1212… bụ ọnụọgụ ntụpọ nke 12 na-emegharị ruo mgbe ebighị ebi. Kwe ka x=0.1212…, wepụ x na 100x iji nweta 99x=12. Gbanwee ọnụọgụ ntụpọ a ka ọ bụrụ irighiri ọnụọgụ.
l-m-m2-b04-14.s.s1.prompt: Kedu irighiri ọnụọgụ na-anọchi anya otu ọnụọgụ ahụ dị ka 0.1212…?

l-m-m2-b04-14.s.s1.r.c: 12/90 bụ maka mgbe ọnụọgụ ndị na-adịghị emegharị dị tupu akụkụ na-emegharị amalite.
l-m-m2-b04-14.s.s1.r.d: Ị gụrụ 1212… site n'azụ gawa n'ihu.
l-m-m2-b04-14.s.s2.model.0: Site na 99x=12, x=12/99, nke na-adị mfe bụrụ 4/33, ya mere ha bụ otu ọnụọgụ.

l-m-m2-b04-22.title: Kedu ka e si dee 8×4 dịka ike nke 2?
l-m-m2-b04-22.goal: Gbanwee 8×4 ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ike, ụdị ọzọ (nhatanha, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere ọ pụtara otu ihe.
l-m-m2-b04-22.material: 8 bụ 2×2×2=2³, 4 bụ 2×2=2². Dee 8×4 dịka otu ike nke 2 ma nyochaa uru ya.
l-m-m2-b04-22.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nke nwere otu uru na 8×4?

l-m-m2-b04-30.title: Kedu ka a ga-esi gbanwee nsogbu afọ ka ọ bụrụ nhatanha?
l-m-m2-b04-30.goal: Gbanwee ahịrịokwu gbasara afọ okenye na nwa ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (nhatanha, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere ha ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-m2-b04-30.material: Ka afọ okenye bụrụ x afọ, nke nwa bụrụ y afọ. Ngụkọta afọ ha bụ 50, afọ okenye dị mkpụmkpụ 5 karịa okpukpu 4 nke afọ nwa.
l-m-m2-b04-30.s.s1.prompt: Kedu usoro nhatanha pụtara otu ihe na ahịrịokwu ndị a?
l-m-m2-b04-30.s.s1.r.a: I dere “erughị 5” dịka +5 n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi.
l-m-m2-b04-30.s.s1.r.b: Ị dere mmekọrịta okenye na nwa n'azụ.
l-m-m2-b04-30.s.s1.r.c: Ị jiri ọdịiche kama ngụkọta. “Ngụkọta bụ 50” bụ x+y=50.
l-m-m2-b04-30.s.s1.explain: Ngụkọta bụ x+y=50, “erughị 5 na okpukpu 4” bụ 4y−5. Idozi na-enye nwa 11, okenye 39.
l-m-m2-b04-30.s.s2.model.0: “Ngụkọta bụ 50” bụ x+y=50, “erughị 5 n'okpukpu 4” bụ x=4y−5, ya mere ọ pụtara otu ihe na ahịrịokwu.
l-m-m2-b04-30.s.s2.model.1: Itinye x=39, y=11 na-enye ngụkọta 50, 4×11−5=39, ya mere nhatanha abụọ dabara n'ahịrịokwu.

l-m-m2-b04-38.topic: Akụkụ nkuku hà nhata, akụkụ ogologo hà nhata
l-m-m2-b04-38.goal: Gbanwee eziokwu na akụkụ nkuku abụọ hà nhata ka ọ bụrụ ụzọ ngosipụta ọzọ (nhatanha, tebụl, eserese, ma ọ bụ okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji nwee otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-m-m2-b04-38.material: Na triangle ABC, ∠B=∠C=50°. Gbanwee eziokwu a ka ọ bụrụ nkwupụta gbasara ogologo akụkụ.
l-m-m2-b04-38.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nke na-egosipụta otu ihe ahụ n'ihe gbasara ogologo akụkụ?
l-m-m2-b04-38.s.s1.r.a: BC dị n'ihu ∠A. Akụkụ ndị dị n'ihu ∠B na ∠C bụ AC na AB.
l-m-m2-b04-38.s.s1.r.b: Ka akụkụ atọ niile hà nhata, akụkụ nkuku atọ niile ga-abụ 60°.
l-m-m2-b04-38.s.s1.r.c: Akụkụ ndị dị n'ihu akụkụ nkuku hà nhata nwere otu ogologo. Ọ bụghị okpukpu abụọ.
l-m-m2-b04-38.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na akụkụ nkuku abụọ hà nhata, ọ bụ triangle nwere akụkụ abụọ hà nhata, akụkụ ndị dị n'ihu ha AC na AB hà nhata.
l-m-m2-b04-38.s.s2.model.0: ∠B na ∠C hà nhata, ya mere akụkụ ndị dị n'ihu ha AC na AB nwekwara otu ogologo.
l-m-m2-b04-38.s.s2.model.1: Triangle nwere akụkụ nkuku abụọ hà nhata bụ triangle nwere akụkụ abụọ hà nhata, ya mere enwere ike idegharị ya dịka AB=AC.

l-m-m2-b05-26.title: Ịgbanwe “opekata mpe” na “erughị” ka ọ bụrụ akara
l-m-m2-b05-26.goal: Gbanwee ahịrịokwu “opekata mpe −2 ma erughị 5” gaa n’ụdị ọzọ, kọwakwa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-m2-b05-26.material: x bụ ọnụọgụ dịkarịa ala −2 ma dị obere karịa 5. Dee okwu ndị a dịka inequality.
l-m-m2-b05-26.s.s1.prompt: Kedu inequality nwere otu ihe ọ pụtara?
l-m-m2-b05-26.s.s1.r.a: Ọnụọgụ pere mpe ga-abụ nke mbụ. Usoro ahụ gbagwojuru.
l-m-m2-b05-26.s.s1.r.b: Ọ pere mpe karịa 5, ya mere 5 agụnyeghị.
l-m-m2-b05-26.s.s1.r.d: −2 gụnyere ma 5 agụnyeghị. Oke ndị ahụ agbanwere.
l-m-m2-b05-26.s.s1.explain: "At least" bụ ≤ ma "less than" bụ <. "At least −2 and less than 5" bụ −2≤x<5.
l-m-m2-b05-26.s.s2.model.0: "At least −2" gụnyere −2, ya mere jiri ≤, ma "less than 5" anaghị agụnye 5, ya mere jiri <, na-enye −2≤x<5.
l-m-m2-b05-26.s.s2.model.1: x=−2 ka a na-anabata ma x=5 abụghị, ya mere e dere ya dị ka −2≤x<5.

l-m-m2-b05-27.title: Ịgbanwe nkọwa eserese ka ọ bụrụ okwu mgbakọ
l-m-m2-b05-27.topic: Site na nkọwa ruo nhatanha nke ahịrị
l-m-m2-b05-27.goal: Gbanwee nkọwa nke ahịrị ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (okwu mgbakọ, tebụl, ihe oyiyi, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere ọ pụtara otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-m2-b05-27.material: Ahịrị ahụ na-ezute y-axis na isi (0, 3). Oge ọ bụla x na-abawanye site na 2, y na-ebelata site na 6. Dee ahịrị a dị ka nhatanha.
l-m-m2-b05-27.s.s1.r.a: Mgbe x na-abawanye site na 2, ọ na-ebelata site na 6. Mgbe x na-abawanye site na 1, ọ na-ebelata site na 3.
l-m-m2-b05-27.s.s1.r.b: Ị gbanwere akara nke slope na intercept.
l-m-m2-b05-27.s.s1.r.d: Ị dere slope n'azụ dị ka akụkụ.
l-m-m2-b05-27.s.s1.explain: Mgbe x na-abawanye site na 1, y na-ebelata site na 3, ya mere slope bụ −3, ma y-intercept bụ 3, ya mere y=−3x+3.
l-m-m2-b05-27.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe x na-abawanye site na 2, y na-ebelata site na 6, ya mere slope bụ −3, ma na y-intercept 3 ọ bụ y=−3x+3.
l-m-m2-b05-27.s.s2.model.1: Itinye x=2 na-enye −3×2+3=−3, nke hà nhata na 3−6, ya mere ọ bụ otu ahịrị dị ka nkọwa ahụ.

l-m-m2-b05-29.material: N'etiti kaadị 20, 5 bụ kaadị mmeri. Dee ohere ịdọta kaadị mmeri mgbe ị na-ewepụta otu, dị ka akụkụ na dị ka pasent.
l-m-m2-b05-29.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nke na-egosi otu ohere ahụ?
l-m-m2-b05-29.s.s1.r.a: Ị belatara 5/20 ka ọ bụrụ 1/5 n'njehie.
l-m-m2-b05-29.s.s1.r.c: Ị dere kaadị 5 ozugbo dị ka pasent.
l-m-m2-b05-29.s.s1.r.d: Ị gbanwere ngụkọta na ọnụọgụ kaadị mmeri.
l-m-m2-b05-29.s.s2.model.0: Ibelata 5/20 site na 5 na-enye 1/4, ma 1/4×100=25%, ya mere ọ bụ otu ohere ahụ.
l-m-m2-b05-29.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụ 25 n'ime kaadị 100, ya mere 1/4 hà nhata na 25%.

l-m-m2-b05-30.title: Pythagorean theorem site n'ebe nke square
l-m-m2-b05-30.goal: Gbanwee Pythagorean theorem ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (okwu mgbakọ, tebụl, ihe oyiyi, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere ọ pụtara otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-m2-b05-30.material: E mere squares n'akụkụ abụọ dị n'akụkụ akụkụ ziri ezi, ma ebe ha bụ 9 na 16. Kwuo Pythagorean theorem ọzọ n'okwu ebe nke squares ma chọta hypotenuse.
l-m-m2-b05-30.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ebe nke square dị na hypotenuse na ogologo hypotenuse?
l-m-m2-b05-30.s.s1.r.b: Ị wepụrụ 16−9. Ị ga-agbakwunye ebe abụọ ahụ.
l-m-m2-b05-30.s.s1.r.d: Ebe bụ 25, ma ogologo bụ square root ya, 5.
l-m-m2-b05-30.s.s1.explain: Nchikota ebe nke squares dị n'akụkụ abụọ hà nhata na ebe nke square dị na hypotenuse. 9+16=25, ya mere hypotenuse bụ 5.
l-m-m2-b05-30.s.s2.model.0: Ịgbakwunye ebe nke squares abụọ pere mpe na-enye 9+16=25, ya mere ebe dị na hypotenuse bụ 25 ma hypotenuse bụ 5.
l-m-m2-b05-30.s.s2.model.1: a²+b²=c² pụtara na nchikota ebe hà nhata, ya mere hypotenuse bụ square root nke 25, nke bụ 5.

l-m-m2-b0s5-03.title: Kedu ka e si dee mpaghara ogige dịka ngụkọta?
l-m-m2-b0s5-03.goal: Degharịa mpaghara ogige e nyere dịka ngwaahịa gaa n'ụdị ọzọ (expression, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere ọ pụtara otu ihe.
l-m-m2-b0s5-03.material: E nwere ogige rektangulu obosara 2x m, ogologo (x+3) m. Enwere ike ide mpaghara ya 2x(x+3). Ị chọrọ ideghachi ya dịka ngụkọta kama ngwaahịa.
l-m-m2-b0s5-03.s.s1.prompt: Kedu expression pụtara otu ihe na 2x(x+3)?
l-m-m2-b0s5-03.s.s1.r.a: E mụbaghị 3 dị n'ime parentheses na 2x.
l-m-m2-b0s5-03.s.s1.r.b: Ị kwesịrị ịmụba, ma ị gbakwụnyere, dịka 2x+x+3.
l-m-m2-b0s5-03.s.s1.r.d: Ị gbakọrọ 2x×x dịka 2x. x×x bụ x².
l-m-m2-b0s5-03.s.s1.explain: Site na distributive law, 2x×x=2x², 2x×3=6x, ngụkọta bụ 2x²+6x. Itinye x=2 na-enye 20 maka ha abụọ.
l-m-m2-b0s5-03.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ kewaa ogologo ka ọ bụrụ x na 3, mpaghara bụ 2x·x na 2x·3, ngụkọta na-enye 2x²+6x.
l-m-m2-b0s5-03.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe x=2, 2x(x+3)=20, 2x²+6x=8+12=20, hà nhata, ya mere ha pụtara otu ihe.

l-m-m2-b01-15.title: Gịnị na-eme akara inequality ma anyị mụbaa akụkụ abụọ na −1?
l-m-m2-b01-15.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ maka iji nọmba negative tụnyere nha, họrọ nke dabara karịa ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-m2-b01-15.material: Mụbaa akụkụ abụọ nke 2<5 na −1, tụnyere nha. A: −2<−5. Ụzọ akara inequality na-adị otu. B: −2>−5. Ụzọ akara inequality na-agbanwe.
l-m-m2-b01-15.s.s1.r.a: Nkwupụta abụọ ahụ na-emegide ibe ha, ya mere ha abụọ enweghị ike ịdị mma.
l-m-m2-b01-15.s.s1.r.b: N'ahịrị nọmba, −5 dị n'aka ekpe nke −2, ya mere −2 ka ukwuu.
l-m-m2-b01-15.s.s1.r.c: −2>−5, ya mere nkwupụta B ziri ezi.
l-m-m2-b01-15.s.s1.explain: −2 dị n'aka nri nke −5, ya mere −2>−5. Mgbe a mụbara na nọmba negative, ụzọ akara inequality na-agbanwe.
l-m-m2-b01-15.s.s2.model.0: N'ahịrị nọmba, −5 dị n'aka ekpe nke −2, ya mere −2>−5. Nke a mere ụzọ akara inequality ji agbanwe mgbe a mụbara na nọmba negative.
l-m-m2-b01-15.s.s2.model.1: Ịmụba 2<5 na −1 na-enye −2 na −5, −2 ka ukwuu. Nha ndị ahụ tụgharịrị, ya mere B, nke akara inequality ya gbanwere ụzọ, ziri ezi.

l-m-m2-b01-19.title: Ànyị kwesịrị ịlele naanị otu nhatanha maka ngwọta simultaneous equations?
l-m-m2-b01-19.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara ịlele ngwọta simultaneous equations, họrọ nke dabara karịa ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-m2-b01-19.material: Onye kwuru na ngwọta x+y=5, 2x−y=1 bụ (x, y)=(4, 1). Ụzọ nlele A: tinye ya naanị na nhatanha mbụ. B: tinye ya na nhatanha abụọ ahụ.
l-m-m2-b01-19.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ụzọ dabara adaba ikpebi ma ọ bụ ngwọta?
l-m-m2-b01-19.s.s1.o.a: A: Ịlele naanị nhatanha mbụ ezuola
l-m-m2-b01-19.s.s1.r.a: (4, 1) dabara na nhatanha mbụ, ma nhatanha nke abụọ na-enye 7.
l-m-m2-b01-19.s.s1.r.b: Ị ga-ahụ ma x na y hà dabara na nhatanha abụọ ọnụ.
l-m-m2-b01-19.s.s1.o.c: Ịlele naanị nhatanha nke abụọ ezuola
l-m-m2-b01-19.s.s1.r.c: Ọbụna ma ewepụ ya n'ọnọdụ a, na uru ndị ọzọ ị nwere ike ghara ịhụ mmejọ na nhatanha mbụ.
l-m-m2-b01-19.s.s1.o.d: B: Tinye ya na nhatanha abụọ
l-m-m2-b01-19.s.s1.explain: Ngwọta ga-emezu nhatanha abụọ. Maka (4, 1), 2×4−1=7, ya mere ọ dabaghị na nhatanha nke abụọ.
l-m-m2-b01-19.s.s2.model.0: (4, 1) dabara na x+y=5, ma ọ na-enye 2x−y=7, nke na-adabaghị na nhatanha nke abụọ, ya mere ị ga-enyocha ha abụọ.
l-m-m2-b01-19.s.s2.model.1: Ngwọta ga-emezu nhatanha abụọ n'otu oge, ya mere ị kwesịrị ịlele dịka B. A na-ele naanị nke mbụ, ya mere ọbụna ngwọta ezighị ezi ga-agafe.

l-m-m2-b01-23.title: Kandụl nke toro ogologo na mbido ọ na-ere ogologo oge?
l-m-m2-b01-23.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara ogologo oge kandụl abụọ na-ere, họrọ nke dabara karịa, kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-m2-b01-23.material: Kandụl A malitere 20 cm, na-adị mkpụmkpụ 2 cm kwa 1 minute. Kandụl B malitere 30 cm, na-adị mkpụmkpụ 5 cm kwa 1 minute. C: B, nke toro ogologo na mbido, na-ere ogologo oge. D: I kwesịkwara ilele ọsọ ha si adalata.
l-m-m2-b01-23.s.s1.r.a: B na-agwụ n'ime 30÷5=6 minutes, A na-agwụ n'ime 20÷2=10 minutes.
l-m-m2-b01-23.s.s1.r.b: C na-ekwu na B na-ere ogologo oge, nke na-emegide D.
l-m-m2-b01-23.s.s1.r.d: D kwuru nke ọma, ị ga-elelekwa ọsọ ha si adalata.
l-m-m2-b01-23.s.s1.explain: A na-agwụ n'ime 20÷2=10 minutes, B n'ime 30÷5=6 minutes. Ị pụghị ikpebi site n'ogologo mmalite naanị.
l-m-m2-b01-23.s.s2.model.0: A na-ewe 20÷2=10 minutes, B na-ewe 30÷5=6 minutes, ya mere B na-agwụ mbụ. Ọsọ mbelata ha dị iche, ya mere D ziri ezi.
l-m-m2-b01-23.s.s2.model.1: B toro ogologo na mbido, ma ọ na-adị mkpụmkpụ 5 cm kwa nkeji ma na-adị mkpụmkpụ ngwa ngwa, ya mere ogologo mmalite naanị agaghị egosi nke ga-ere ogologo oge.

l-m-m2-b01-27.s.s1.prompt: Nkwupụta onye dabara karịa bụ nke dị aṅaa?
l-m-m2-b01-27.s.s1.r.a: Ọ hapụrụ ọnọdụ 80° bụ base angle.
l-m-m2-b01-27.s.s1.r.b: A kwuru naanị otu ọnọdụ; B sara mbara karịa.
l-m-m2-b01-27.s.s1.r.c: Nkwupụta B na-egosi ọnọdụ abụọ ahụ; ya mere dabara.

l-m-m2-b01-31.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta proportion segments parallel line mepụtara; họrọ nke dabara ma kọwaa.
l-m-m2-b01-31.material: Na triangle ABC, D na E dị na AB, AC, DE∥BC. Proportions ịchọta EC mgbe AD=3, DB=2, AE=4.5. P: 3:2=4.5:EC. Q: 3:5=4.5:EC.
l-m-m2-b01-31.s.s1.prompt: Proportion dabara bụ nke dị aṅaa?
l-m-m2-b01-31.s.s1.r.a: Ihe na-ejikọta AB (=5) abụghị EC kama AC.
l-m-m2-b01-31.s.s1.r.c: EC e nwetara na equations abụọ bụ 3 na 7.5, dị iche; ha abụọ agaghị abụ eziokwu.
l-m-m2-b01-31.s.s1.r.d: P, AD:DB=AE:EC, dabara njirimara parallel lines.
l-m-m2-b01-31.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ DE∥BC, AD:DB=AE:EC. Site na 3:2=4.5:EC, EC=3.
l-m-m2-b01-31.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ DE∥BC, AD:DB=AE:EC; ya mere 3:2=4.5:EC, EC=3.

l-m-m2-b02-03.title: x²+x² hà nhata x⁴ ka ọ bụ 2x²?
l-m-m2-b02-03.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ iji mee x²+x² dị mfe, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-m2-b02-03.material: A mere x²+x² ka ọ dị mfe. A: x²+x²=x⁴ (gbakwunye exponents). B: x²+x²=2x² (e nwere x² abụọ).
l-m-m2-b02-03.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụrụ x=3, x²+x²=18 mana x⁴=81; ha dị iche.
l-m-m2-b02-03.s.s1.r.b: x⁴ na 2x² dị iche mgbe x=3: 81 na 18.
l-m-m2-b02-03.s.s1.r.c: Mgbe x=3, 2x² bụ 18, nke hà nhata x²+x².
l-m-m2-b02-03.s.s1.explain: Ịmụba na-agbakwunye exponents, mana mgbakwunye na-achịkọta x² abụọ; ya mere ọ bụ 2x². Ọ bụrụ x=3, 9+9=18=2×9.
l-m-m2-b02-03.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ x=3, x²+x²=9+9=18 na 2x²=18. x⁴ bụ 81; ya mere A ezighi ezi.
l-m-m2-b02-03.s.s2.model.1: Ịchịkọta x² abụọ na-enye 2x². Ịgbakwunye exponents bụ naanị maka mmụba; na mgbakwunye, a na-agbakwunye coefficients.

l-m-m2-b02-07.topic: Site na decimal na-emegharị gaa na fraction
l-m-m2-b02-07.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ maka ide 0.444… dịka fraction, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-m2-b02-07.material: E dere 0.444… (4 na-emegharị ruo mgbe ebighị ebi) dịka fraction. A: ọ bụ 4/10. B: ọ bụ 4/9.
l-m-m2-b02-07.s.s1.r.a: 4/10=0.4 bụ decimal na-akwụsị. Ọ dị iche na 0.444….
l-m-m2-b02-07.s.s1.r.c: 4/10 na 4/9 nwere uru dị iche; ha abụọ agaghị abụ otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-m2-b02-07.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na x=0.444…, mgbe ahụ 10x−x=4, ya mere 9x=4 na x=4/9.
l-m-m2-b02-07.s.s2.model.0: Ịkekọrịta 4/9 na-enye 0.444…, ma 4/10 kwụsịrị na 0.4. Ya mere 4/9 bụ azịza ziri ezi.
l-m-m2-b02-07.s.s2.model.1: Site na x=0.444…, 10x−x=4, ya mere 9x=4 na x=4/9. Nke a bụ ihe mere ọnụ ọgụgụ dị n'okpuru akara nkewa ji bụrụ 9, ọ bụghị 10.

l-m-m2-b03-25.title: Gịnị bụ nhatanha mgbe e bugara graph na ntụziaka y site na 5?
l-m-m2-b03-25.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta maka ntụgharị y=2x−3, họrọ nke dabara karịa ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-m2-b03-25.material: E bugara graph y=2x−3 site na 5 n'akụkụ y. A: y=2x−3+5=2x+2. B: y=2(x+5)−3=2x+7.
l-m-m2-b03-25.s.s1.r.a: Ị ga-agbakwunye 5 na y ka ọ kwaga n'akụkụ y site na 5. 2x+7 bụ nhatanha e bugoro elu site na 10.
l-m-m2-b03-25.s.s1.r.c: y-intercepts nke nhatanha abụọ dị iche, 2 na 7, ya mere ha abụọ enweghị ike ịdị mma.
l-m-m2-b03-25.s.s1.r.d: Nhatanha A ziri ezi n'ihi na ịgbakwunye 5 na y-intercept −3 na-enye 2.
l-m-m2-b03-25.s.s1.explain: Ịkwaga n'akụkụ y site na 5 na-agbakwunye 5 na y-intercept. −3+5=2, ya mere y=2x+2.
l-m-m2-b03-25.s.s2.model.0: Ịkwaga n'akụkụ y site na 5 na-agbakwunye 5 na y value, ya mere y=2x−3+5=2x+2. 2x+7 nke B ezighị ezi n'ihi na y-intercept rịrị elu site na 10.
l-m-m2-b03-25.s.s2.model.1: Ịgbakwunye 5 na y-intercept −3 nke y=2x−3 na-enye 2, ya mere y=2x+2. Slope na-adị 2, ya mere A ziri ezi.

l-m-m2-b03-31.material: Banyere ọnọdụ circumcenter nke right triangle ABC nwere ∠C=90°, P kwuru ọ bụ midpoint hypotenuse AB. Q kwuru ọ bụ vertex right-angle C.
l-m-m2-b03-31.s.s1.r.a: Anya C ruo A na B nwere ike ghara ịdị otu, ya mere ọ bụghị circumcenter.
l-m-m2-b03-31.s.s1.r.c: Ọnọdụ abụọ ahụ dị iche, ya mere ha abụọ enweghị ike ịdị mma.
l-m-m2-b03-31.s.s1.r.d: Circumcenter nke right triangle bụ n'ezie midpoint nke hypotenuse.
l-m-m2-b03-31.s.s1.explain: Circumcenter nke right triangle bụ midpoint nke hypotenuse. Anya site n'isi a ruo A, B, C hà nhata.
l-m-m2-b03-31.s.s2.model.0: Circumcenter bụ isi dị otu anya na vertices atọ, n'ime right triangle isi ahụ bụ midpoint hypotenuse, ya mere P ziri ezi.
l-m-m2-b03-31.s.s2.model.1: C na-adịkarị anya dị iche na A na B, ya mere ọ pụghị ịbụ circumcenter. Midpoint hypotenuse dị otu anya na ha atọ.

l-m-m2-b05-32.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ banyere nha akụkụ n'èzí nke triangle, họrọ nke kwesịrị ekwesị karịa, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-m2-b05-32.material: N'triangle ABC, ∠A=50° na ∠B=60°. Chọta akụkụ n'èzí na C. P: Chọta ∠C=70°, mgbe ahụ 180°−70°=110°. Q: 50°+60°=110°.
l-m-m2-b05-32.s.s1.o.a: Naanị P ziri ezi. Q bụ ọdịdị
l-m-m2-b05-32.s.s1.r.a: Q bụkwa ụzọ ziri ezi nke na-eji ọmụmụ ihe akụkụ n'èzí.
l-m-m2-b05-32.s.s1.o.b: Ha abụọ ziri ezi. Nchikota akụkụ abụọ dị n'ime hà nhata na akụkụ n'èzí
l-m-m2-b05-32.s.s1.o.c: Naanị Q ziri ezi. P adịghị mma
l-m-m2-b05-32.s.s1.r.c: P bụkwa ụzọ ziri ezi, na-achọta ya site na ∠C.
l-m-m2-b05-32.s.s1.o.d: Azịza nke ụzọ abụọ ahụ dị iche
l-m-m2-b05-32.s.s1.explain: ∠C=70° na akụkụ n'èzí=180°−70°=110°. Nchikota akụkụ abụọ dị n'ime na-adịghị n'akụkụ, 50°+60°, bụkwa 110°.
l-m-m2-b05-32.s.s2.model.0: P na-agafe site na ∠C=70° iji nweta 110°, ma Q na-eji nchikota akụkụ abụọ dị n'ime, 110°, ya mere otu uru na-apụta.
l-m-m2-b05-32.s.s2.model.1: Akụkụ n'èzí bụ 180°−∠C ma ∠C=180°−(∠A+∠B), ya mere ọ hà nhata na ∠A+∠B.

l-m-m2-b05-33.material: Triangle nwere akụkụ 5, 7, 9. A: 25+49=74 ma 9²=81, ya mere ọ bụghị triangle akụkụ ziri ezi. B: 5+7>9, ya mere ọ bụ triangle akụkụ ziri ezi.

l-m-m2-b05-33.s.s1.r.b: A na-ekwu mba ma B na-ekwu ee, ya mere ha dị iche.

l-m-m2-b05-34.material: Chọta ohere na nchikota nke dice abụọ bụ 8. A: E nwere ụzọ 5, (2,6), (3,5), (4,4), (5,3), (6,2), ya mere 5/36. B: E nwere ụzọ 3, (2,6), (3,5), (4,4), ya mere 3/36.

l-m-m2-b05-34.s.s1.r.c: Azịza dị iche, ya mere ha abụọ enweghị ike ịbụ ndị ziri ezi.
l-m-m2-b05-34.s.s1.r.d: A ziri ezi. E nwere ikpe 5 ebe nchikota bụ 8.
l-m-m2-b05-34.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ị kewaa dice abụọ ahụ, 5 n'ime ikpe 36 nwere nchikota 8, ya mere ọ bụ 5/36.
l-m-m2-b05-34.s.s2.model.0: E nwere dice abụọ, ya mere (2,6) na (6,2) bụ ikpe dị iche, nke na-eme ikpe 5 na 5/36.

l-m-m2-b05-35.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ banyere ma 7/48 bụ decimal na-akwụsị, họrọ nke kwesịrị ekwesị karịa, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-m2-b05-35.material: Chọpụta ma 7/48 bụ decimal na-akwụsị. A: Ana m kewaa ya ma ọ kwụsịghị mgbe ọtụtụ ebe gasịrị, ya mere o yiri decimal na-akwụsịghị. B: 48=2⁴×3 nwere ihe na-ekewa prime 3, ya mere ọ bụ decimal na-akwụsịghị.
l-m-m2-b05-35.s.s1.prompt: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ahụ ma họrọ nke dị ntụkwasị obi karịa.
l-m-m2-b05-35.s.s1.o.a: A: Ịkewa ebe ole na ole zuru ezu
l-m-m2-b05-35.s.s1.r.a: Ebe ole na ole naanị enweghị ike ịgwa gị n'ezie ma ọ na-akwụsị.
l-m-m2-b05-35.s.s1.r.b: A lere naanị akụkụ ya, ya mere ọ dịghị doro anya.
l-m-m2-b05-35.s.s1.o.c: B: Ị nwere ike ịmata n'ezie site n'ihe prime nke onye na-ekewa
l-m-m2-b05-35.s.s1.r.d: Onye na-ekewa 48 nwere ihe prime 3, ya mere ọ bụghị decimal na-akwụsị.
l-m-m2-b05-35.s.s1.explain: 7/48 bụ akụkụ na-enweghị ike ibelata ma onye na-ekewa ya nwere 3, ya mere ọ bụ decimal na-akwụsịghị (0.14583…).
l-m-m2-b05-35.s.s2.model.0: Onye na-ekewa nke akụkụ na-enweghị ike ibelata 7/48 nwere ihe prime 3, ya mere ị nwere ike ikwu n'ezie na ọ bụ decimal na-akwụsịghị.
l-m-m2-b05-35.s.s2.model.1: Ịkewa ebe ole na ole enweghị ike ịgwa gị ebe ọ na-akwụsị, ya mere B, nke na-elele ihe prime, dị ntụkwasị obi karịa.

l-m-m2-b0s5-08.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara square ịbụ n'ime rectangles, họrọ nke dabara karịa ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-m2-b0s5-08.material: Rectangle bụ quadrilateral nke angles anọ ya niile bụ right angles. E nwere echiche abụọ gbasara square. (A) Square nwere akụkụ niile hà nhata, ya mere ọ bụghị rectangle. (B) Square nwere right angles anọ, ya mere ọ bụ rectangle.

l-m-m2-b0s5-08.s.s1.r.a: Nkọwa rectangle enweghị ọnọdụ gbasara ogologo akụkụ.
l-m-m2-b0s5-08.s.s1.r.b: Nkọwa rectangle enweghị ọnọdụ dị otu ahụ.

l-m-m2-b0s5-08.s.s1.o.d: (B) O nwere right angles anọ, ya mere ọ bụ rectangle
l-m-m2-b0s5-08.s.s1.explain: Nkọwa rectangle bụ naanị quadrilateral nwere right angles anọ. Square na-emezu nke a kwa, ya mere ọ bụ rectangle.
l-m-m2-b0s5-08.s.s2.model.0: Rectangle chọrọ naanị akụkụ anọ ziri ezi; o nweghị iwu gbasara ogologo akụkụ. Ya mere square, nke akụkụ ya niile hà nhata, bụkwa rectangle.

l-m-m2-b01-20.title: Ịhọrọ a dabara adaba na x+y=a
l-m-m2-b01-20.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha maka a na simultaneous equations x+y=a, x−y=2, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m2-b01-20.material: Kpebie a n'ime simultaneous equations x+y=a, x−y=2. x na y ga-abụ natural numbers, anyị chọrọ a kacha nta nke na-edobe ọnọdụ ahụ. Ndị ga-ekwe omume bụ 2, 4, 5, 6.
l-m-m2-b01-20.s.s1.r.a: x=2, y=0, ya mere y abụghị natural number.
l-m-m2-b01-20.s.s1.r.c: x=3.5 na y=1.5 abụghị natural numbers.
l-m-m2-b01-20.s.s1.r.d: x=4 na y=2 bụ natural numbers, ma e nwere a dị obere, a=4.

l-m-m2-b01-24.topic: Isi dị na graph nke linear function
l-m-m2-b01-24.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha mgbe ị na-ahọrọ isi n'ahịrị, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m2-b01-24.material: Kaa isi n'ahịrị y=−2x+10. y-coordinate ga-abụ positive, n'ime isi na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ anyị chọrọ nke x-coordinate ya kacha ukwuu.
l-m-m2-b01-24.s.s1.prompt: Kedu onye a họpụtara na-emezu ọnọdụ niile?
l-m-m2-b01-24.s.s1.r.a: Ọ dị n'ahịrị, ma y-coordinate ya bụ negative.
l-m-m2-b01-24.s.s1.r.c: Ọ dị n'ahịrị, ma y-coordinate bụ 0, ya mere ọ bụghị positive.
l-m-m2-b01-24.s.s1.r.d: −2×4+10=2, ya mere ọ bụghị isi dị n'ahịrị.
l-m-m2-b01-24.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na y>0, mgbe ahụ −2x+10>0, ya mere x<5. N'ime ndị a họpụtara, (4, 2) bụ naanị isi dị n'ahịrị nke na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ.
l-m-m2-b01-24.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ x=4, y=−8+10=2, nke dị n'ahịrị ma positive. (5, 0) anaghị arụ ọrụ n'ihi na y bụ 0, ọ bụghị positive.
l-m-m2-b01-24.s.s2.model.1: (4, 3) adịghị n'ahịrị, y nke (6, −2) bụ negative. y nke (5, 0) abụghịkwa positive. Ya mere (4, 2) fọdụrụ bụ nke ziri ezi.

l-m-m2-b01-32.s.s1.prompt: Ladder kacha mkpụmkpụ mezuru ọnọdụ bụ nke dị aṅaa?

l-m-m2-b01-32.s.s1.r.c: Ọ ruru, ma ọ dị ogologo karịa 13 m, ya mere adịghị dabara.
l-m-m2-b01-32.s.s1.r.d: Ọ ruru, ma ọ dị ogologo nke ukwuu, o siri ike ijide.
l-m-m2-b01-32.s.s1.explain: Ebe 5²+12²=13², 13 m dabara kpọmkwem. Nke dị mkpụmkpụ agaghị eru, nke toro ogologo ga-eru ma o sie ike ijide.
l-m-m2-b01-32.s.s2.model.0: Base dị 5 m site na wall; ogologo ga-eru elu 12 m bụ √(5²+12²)=13m. 12m dị mkpụmkpụ; ya mere 13m bụ nke kacha mkpụmkpụ.

l-m-m2-b01-36.material: Ị na-adọta marble otu n’ime igbe. Ohere inweta mmeri ga-abụ opekata mpe 40%; n’ime igbe ndị mezuru, ịchọrọ prize score kacha elu.
l-m-m2-b01-36.s.s1.r.a: Probability bụ 40%, mezuru condition, ma score ya dị ala karịa D.
l-m-m2-b01-36.s.s1.o.c: C: ndị mmeri 5 n’ime 10, ụgwọ 2 points
l-m-m2-b01-36.s.s1.r.c: Ohere bụ 50%, ya mere ọ mezuru ọnọdụ, mana akara ya dị ala karịa D.
l-m-m2-b01-36.s.s1.o.d: D: ndị mmeri 5 n’ime 12, ụgwọ 4 points
l-m-m2-b01-36.s.s1.explain: Igbe ndị ohere ha bụ 40% ma ọ bụ karịa bụ A (40%), C (50%), na D (ihe dị ka 41.7%). N’ime ha, D nwere akara kacha elu.
l-m-m2-b01-36.s.s2.model.0: Ohere bụ 2/5=40% maka A, 3/10=30% maka B, 1/2 maka C, na 5/12, ihe dị ka 41.7%, maka D. B erughị 40%, hapụ ya.
l-m-m2-b01-36.s.s2.model.1: N’etiti A, C, D ndị ruru 40% ma ọ bụ karịa, akara ụgwọ bụ 3, 2, na 4; họrọ D nke kacha elu.

l-m-m2-b02-04.material: Mee rectangle ogologo ya karịrị obosara site na 2 cm. Perimeter ga-abụ 20 cm ma ọ bụ obere; ịchọrọ mpaghara kacha ukwuu.
l-m-m2-b02-04.s.s1.prompt: Atụmatụ dị aṅaa mezuru ọnọdụ niile ma nwee mpaghara kacha ukwuu?
l-m-m2-b02-04.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ, mana e nwere atụmatụ nwere mpaghara karịrị 15 cm².
l-m-m2-b02-04.s.s1.r.b: Perimeter bụ 24 cm, nke karịrị 20 cm.
l-m-m2-b02-04.s.s1.r.d: Ogologo karịrị obosara naanị 1 cm, nke na-emebi ọnọdụ 2 cm.
l-m-m2-b02-04.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ obosara x na ogologo x+2, perimeter bụ 4x+4≤20, ya mere x≤4. Mgbe x=4, mpaghara bụ 24 cm², nke kacha ukwuu.

l-m-m2-b02-08.topic: Ịkọwa ọnụọgụ ntụpọ na-emegharị ugboro ugboro n'ụzọ dị nso
l-m-m2-b02-08.goal: Tulee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha gbasara ebe ntụpọ ole a ga-eji dee 1/3, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m2-b02-08.material: Ị chọrọ ide 1/3 dị ka ọnụọgụ ntụpọ. Ọdịiche (njehie) ya na uru 1/3 n'ezie ga-adị obere karịa 0.001, ma ịchọrọ iji ebe ntụpọ ole kacha nta. Nhọrọ ndị ahụ bụ 0.3, 0.33, 0.333 na 0.3333.
l-m-m2-b02-08.s.s1.prompt: Kedu uru na-emezu ọnọdụ niile ma bụrụ nke kacha mma?
l-m-m2-b02-08.s.s1.r.a: Njehie ahụ dị ihe dị ka 0.033, nke karịrị 0.001.
l-m-m2-b02-08.s.s1.r.b: Njehie ahụ dị ihe dị ka 0.0033, nke karịrị 0.001.
l-m-m2-b02-08.s.s1.r.d: Njehie ahụ dị obere, ma e nwere uru nwere ebe ole na ole, 0.333.
l-m-m2-b02-08.s.s1.explain: 1/3=0.3333…, ya mere njehie 0.333 dị ihe dị ka 0.00033, nke dị obere karịa 0.001. Njehie 0.33 dị ihe dị ka 0.0033, ya mere ewepụ ya.
l-m-m2-b02-08.s.s2.model.0: Njehie 0.333 dị ihe dị ka 0.00033, nke dị obere karịa 0.001, ma o nwere ebe ntụpọ 3. Njehie 0.33 dị ihe dị ka 0.0033, ya mere ewepụ ya; nke a na-eme ka 0.333 bụrụ nhọrọ ziri ezi.
l-m-m2-b02-08.s.s2.model.1: 0.3333 na-emezukwa ọnọdụ ahụ, ma o nwere otu ebe ọzọ, ya mere họrọ 0.333, nke na-emezu ọnọdụ njehie site n'iji ebe ole kacha nta.

l-m-m2-b02-12.topic: Iji ahaghị nhata nke ahịrị kwụ ọtọ
l-m-m2-b02-12.title: Ịga njem n'ime nkeji 90 ma jiri ụkwụ gaa ebe kacha anya
l-m-m2-b02-12.goal: Tulee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha mgbe ị na-ekpebi ogologo njem ụkwụ, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m2-b02-12.material: Ị na-aga ebe dị kilomita 12 site n'ụlọ. Ịga ije bụ 4 km/h, ịnya igwe bụ 12 km/h. Ị ga-eru ebe ahụ n'ime nkeji 90 ma chọọ ịga ije ogologo kacha ukwuu.
l-m-m2-b02-12.s.s1.prompt: Atụmatụ dị aṅaa na-emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ ma nwee ogologo njem ụkwụ kacha ukwuu?
l-m-m2-b02-12.s.s1.o.a: Jiri ụkwụ gaa 4 km ma jiri igwe gaa 8 km
l-m-m2-b02-12.s.s1.o.b: Jiri ụkwụ gaa 6 km ma jiri igwe gaa 6 km
l-m-m2-b02-12.s.s1.o.c: Jiri ụkwụ gaa 3 km ma jiri igwe gaa 9 km
l-m-m2-b02-12.s.s1.o.d: Jiri ụkwụ gaa 2 km ma jiri igwe gaa 10 km
l-m-m2-b02-12.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-ewe nkeji 80, ya mere ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ, ma e nwere atụmatụ ọzọ nke njem ụkwụ ya dị ogologo.
l-m-m2-b02-12.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ogologo njem ụkwụ bụ x km, mgbe ahụ x/4+(12−x)/12≤1.5, ya bụ x≤3. Ọ bụrụ na x=3, ọ na-ewe kpọmkwem nkeji 90.
l-m-m2-b02-12.s.s2.model.0: Ịga ụkwụ 3 km na ịnya igwe 9 km na-ewe nkeji 45+ nkeji 45=90, ya mere ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ oge. 4 km na-ewe nkeji 100, nke karịrị nkeji 90, ya mere 3 km bụ ogologo kacha ukwuu.
l-m-m2-b02-12.s.s2.model.1: Ka ị na-aga ụkwụ karịa, ka oge ọ na-ewe na-abawanye. 3 km, nke na-ewe kpọmkwem nkeji 90, bụ oke ya, ya mere ị gaghị agafe ya.

l-m-m2-b02-16.title: Ịkwakọba ihe 36 n'ime igbe buru ibu na obere
l-m-m2-b02-16.goal: Tulee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha mgbe ị na-ekpebi ọnụọgụ igbe, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m2-b02-16.material: Igbe buru ibu na-ebu ihe 6, obere igbe na-ebu ihe 4. Ị ga-akwakọba ihe 36 niile n'enweghị nke fọdụrụ, ma ị nwere ike iji igbe buru ibu karịa 4. Ị chọrọ iji igbe ole kacha nta.
l-m-m2-b02-16.s.s1.prompt: Atụmatụ dị aṅaa na-emezu ọnọdụ niile ma jiri igbe ole kacha nta?
l-m-m2-b02-16.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-emebi ọnọdụ iji igbe buru ibu karịa 4.
l-m-m2-b02-16.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ, ma ọ na-eji igbe 8, karịa atụmatụ nwere 7.
l-m-m2-b02-16.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ, ma ọ na-eji igbe 9, nke kacha ọtụtụ.
l-m-m2-b02-16.s.s1.explain: N'ime atụmatụ na-emezu 6x+4y=36 na x≤4, nke nwere igbe x+y ole kacha nta bụ (4, 3), nke bụ igbe 7.
l-m-m2-b02-16.s.s2.model.0: Igbe buru ibu 4 na-ebu ihe 24, obere igbe 3 na-ebu ihe 12, nke na-akwakọba ihe 36 niile. Ọ na-eji igbe 7, nke bụ ole kacha nta n'ime atụmatụ na-emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ.
l-m-m2-b02-16.s.s2.model.1: Igbe buru ibu 6 na-emebi oke nke 4, ya mere ewepụ ya. (2, 6) na-eji igbe 8, (0, 9) na-eji 9, ya mere (4, 3) nwere igbe 7 bụ ole kacha nta.

l-m-m2-b02-40.title: Nchịkọta nri nwere ihe 24 ma ọ bụ karịa, ma kwadebe ihe ole na ole
l-m-m2-b02-40.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha n’ịrụ nchịkọta nri, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha dabara adaba, kọwakwa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m2-b02-40.material: Maka nchịkọta nri, họrọ otu nri isi, otu ihe ọṅụṅụ, na otu ihe eji mechie nri. A ga-enwerịrị nchikọta 24 ma ọ bụ karịa, ma ịchọrọ ka ọnụ ọgụgụ ihe a ga-akwadebe pere mpe dịka o kwere.
l-m-m2-b02-40.s.s1.prompt: Atụmatụ dị aṅaa na-emezu ọnọdụ niile ma chọọ ihe ole na ole a ga-akwadebe?

l-m-m2-b02-40.s.s1.o.b: Nri isi 4, ihe ọṅụṅụ 4, ihe eji mechie nri 2
l-m-m2-b02-40.s.s1.r.b: E nwere nchikọta 32, mana a ga-akwadebe ihe 10 n’ozuzu, nke karịrị.
l-m-m2-b02-40.s.s1.o.c: Nri isi 3, ihe ọṅụṅụ 3, ihe eji mechie nri 3
l-m-m2-b02-40.s.s1.o.d: Nri isi 5, ihe ọṅụṅụ 3, ihe eji mechie nri 2
l-m-m2-b02-40.s.s1.r.d: E nwere nchikọta 30, mana a ga-akwadebe ihe 10 n’ozuzu, nke karịrị.
l-m-m2-b02-40.s.s1.explain: A na-achọta ọnụọgụ nchikọta site n’ịmụba. 3×3×3=27 bụ opekata mpe 24, ihe 9 a ga-akwadebe bụ nke kacha nta.
l-m-m2-b02-40.s.s2.model.0: 3×3×3=27 bụ opekata mpe 24, ọnụ ọgụgụ ihe nri a ga-akwadebe bụ 3+3+3=9, nke kacha nta n’etiti atụmatụ ndị mezuru ọnọdụ ahụ.
l-m-m2-b02-40.s.s2.model.1: 2, 3, 3 na-enye 18, nke ezughị; abụọ ndị ọzọ nwere nchikọta zuru ezu mana chọrọ ihe 10. Ya mere 3, 3, 3 nwere ihe 9 bụ nke ziri ezi.

l-m-m2-b03-15.title: Kedu ọnụ ọgụgụ kasị ukwuu mmadụ nwere ike ịbanye na 70000 won site na ego otu?
l-m-m2-b03-15.goal: Mgbe ị na-ekpebi mmadụ ole nwere ike ịbanye, tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m2-b03-15.material: Ụgwọ ịbanye bụ 8000 won maka mmadụ 1, mana maka mmadụ 10 ma ọ bụ karịa ọ bụ 6500 won maka mmadụ 1. Otu ahụ chọrọ ka ọtụtụ mmadụ dịka o kwere mee banye, ngụkọta ya erughị ma ọ bụ hà 70000 won.
l-m-m2-b03-15.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụ ọgụgụ kasị ukwuu nwere ike ịbanye ma na-edebe ọnọdụ?
l-m-m2-b03-15.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-efu 64000 won ma na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ, ma mmadụ karịa nwere ike ịga.
l-m-m2-b03-15.s.s1.explain: Mmadụ 9 enweghị ego mbelata, ya mere ọ bụ 72000 won, mana mmadụ 10 na-akwụ 6500 won onye ọ bụla, ngụkọta 65000. Mmadụ 11 na-efu 71500, nke karịrị oke.
l-m-m2-b03-15.s.s2.model.0: Maka mmadụ 10, ego otu na-enye 10×6500=65000 won, nke bụ 70000 won ma ọ bụ obere. Mmadụ 11 na-efu 71500, nke karịrị, ya mere 10 bụ nke kasị ukwuu.
l-m-m2-b03-15.s.s2.model.1: Mmadụ 9 na-efu 72000 won, nke karịrị, ma site na mmadụ 10 ọnụahịa na-adị ọnụ ala. Ya mere mmadụ kacha ukwuu e kwere bụ 10.

l-m-m2-b03-19.material: Gwakọta mmiri nnu 10% na 20% ka ngụkọta bụrụ 300 g. Concentration ga-abụ 15% ma ọ bụ karịa, ịchọrọ iji mmiri nnu 20% pere mpe dịka o kwere.
l-m-m2-b03-19.s.s1.r.a: E nwere nnu 35 g, ya mere concentration bụ ihe dịka 11.7%.
l-m-m2-b03-19.s.s1.r.b: E nwere nnu 40 g, ya mere concentration bụ ihe dịka 13.3%.
l-m-m2-b03-19.s.s1.r.c: Concentration bụ ihe dịka 16.7%, mana ọ na-eji mmiri nnu 20% karịa.
l-m-m2-b03-19.s.s1.explain: Nnu ga-adịkarịa ala 45 g ka concentration bụrụ 15% ma ọ bụ karịa. Ọ bụ kpọmkwem 45 g mgbe mmiri nnu 20% dị 150 g.
l-m-m2-b03-19.s.s2.model.0: 150 g nke 10% nwere nnu 15 g, 150 g nke 20% nwere 30 g, ngụkọta 45 g, concentration kpọmkwem 15%.
l-m-m2-b03-19.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ mmiri nnu 20% belata ruo 100 g, concentration bụ 13.3%, ezughị. Na 200 g ọnọdụ mezuru ma jiri ọtụtụ, ya mere 150 g kacha mma.

l-m-m2-b03-26.title: Atụmatụ ụgwọ ya bụ 22000 won ma ọ bụ obere ọbụna mgbe ojiji gbanwere
l-m-m2-b03-26.topic: Ụgwọ e gosipụtara dịka linear functions
l-m-m2-b03-26.material: Ojiji kwa ọnwa x GB na-agbanwe site na 4 ruo 7. A: 15000+1000x won, B: 20000 won, C: 12000+2000x won, D: 18000+500x won. Ụgwọ ga-abụ 22000 won ma ọ bụ obere n'ojiji ọ bụla, ịchọrọkwa ụgwọ kacha ala na 4 GB.
l-m-m2-b03-26.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ, ma ụgwọ na 4 GB bụ 20000 won, dị ọnụ karịa A.
l-m-m2-b03-26.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ, ma ụgwọ na 4 GB bụ 20000 won, dị ọnụ karịa A.
l-m-m2-b03-26.s.s1.r.b: Na 7 GB ọ bụ 26000 won, karịrị 22000 won.
l-m-m2-b03-26.s.s1.explain: Na 7 GB, A bụ 22000 won, B 20000 won, D 21500 won, ha niile bụ 22000 ma ọ bụ obere. Na 4 GB, A nwere ụgwọ kacha ala 19000 won.
l-m-m2-b03-26.s.s2.model.0: C bụ 26000 won na 7 GB, ya mere ọ dara. N'ime A, B, D fọdụrụ, A nwere ụgwọ kacha ala na 4 GB, 19000 won, họrọ A.
l-m-m2-b03-26.s.s2.model.1: A bụ 19000 won na 4 GB, 22000 won na 7 GB, ya mere ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ abụọ ma nwee ụgwọ kacha ala na 4 GB. Nke a ziri ezi.

l-m-m2-b03-35.title: Kedu scale ga-eme ka foto buru ibu dịka o kwere n'ime frame?
l-m-m2-b03-35.goal: N'ime scale iji mụbaa foto, tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma ma kọwaa ihe mere ya.
l-m-m2-b03-35.material: Ị ga-amụba foto obosara 12 cm, ịdị elu 16 cm ka ọ bụrụ otu ọdịdị, tinye ya n'ime frame. Ime frame bụ obosara 32 cm, ịdị elu 40 cm, ịchọrọ foto ka o buru ibu dịka o kwere.
l-m-m2-b03-35.s.s1.prompt: Kedu scale kacha ukwuu dabara n'ime frame?
l-m-m2-b03-35.s.s1.r.a: Ọ dabara na 24 cm×32 cm, ma enwere ike ime ka ọ buru ibu.
l-m-m2-b03-35.s.s1.r.c: Ịdị elu bụ 43.2 cm, karịrị 40 cm.
l-m-m2-b03-35.s.s1.explain: Obosara na-enye ruo 32÷12≈2.67 ugboro, ịdị elu na-enye ruo 40÷16=2.5 ugboro. Scale kacha ukwuu na-emezu ha abụọ bụ 2.5.
l-m-m2-b03-35.s.s2.model.0: Ịdị elu 16×2.5=40 dabara kpọmkwem, obosara 12×2.5=30 erughị 32. Na ugboro 2.7 ịdị elu 43.2 karịrị, ya mere 2.5.
l-m-m2-b03-35.s.s2.model.1: Dabere n'obosara ọ nwere ike ruo 2.67, ma ịdị elu naanị ruo 2.5, ya mere nke nta 2.5 na-emezu ha abụọ.

l-m-m2-b03-40.goal: Mgbe ị na-ekpebi ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị ga-ekwe omume, tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma ma kọwaa ihe mere ya.
l-m-m2-b03-40.material: Ọnụọgụ ụzọ ịhọrọ mmadụ 3 n'ime n ma hazie ha ga-abụ 100 ma ọ bụ karịa. Ị chọrọ ka ọnụọgụ ndị ga-ekwe omume n bụrụ nke kacha nta.
l-m-m2-b03-40.s.s1.prompt: Gịnị bụ ọnụ ọgụgụ mmadụ kacha nta na-emezu ọnọdụ niile?
l-m-m2-b03-40.s.s1.r.c: 7×6×5=210 ụzọ na-emezu ọnọdụ, ma mmadụ 6 pere mpe.
l-m-m2-b03-40.s.s1.explain: 6×5×4=120 ụzọ, nke bụ 100 ma ọ bụ karịa, ọ bụkwa mmadụ kacha nta n'etiti ndị a họpụtara.
l-m-m2-b03-40.s.s2.model.0: Mmadụ 6 na-enye 6×5×4=120 ụzọ, nke bụ 100 ma ọ bụ karịa. Mmadụ 5 na-enye 60, ezughị, ya mere 6 bụ nke kacha nta.
l-m-m2-b03-40.s.s2.model.1: Ka mmadụ na-abawanye, ọnọdụ na-abawanye, ya mere mmadụ ole ka achọrọ iji gafee 100 na nke mbụ. Mmadụ 5 na-enye 60, mmadụ 6 na-enye 120, ya mere 6.

l-m-m2-b04-08.topic: Ịzụta ka o kwere mee n'ime mmefu ego
l-m-m2-b04-08.goal: Maka ịzụ snacks otu, tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha dabara adaba, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m2-b04-08.material: Akpa snacks na-efu 1500 won, karama ihe ọṅụṅụ na-efu 2000 won. Mmefu ego bụ 20000 won ma ọ bụ obere, ị chọrọ opekata mpe ihe ọṅụṅụ 3, ịchọrọ ịzụta ihe ọtụtụ dịka o kwere.
l-m-m2-b04-08.s.s1.prompt: Atụmatụ nke na-emezu ọnọdụ niile ma zụta ọtụtụ bụ nke a?
l-m-m2-b04-08.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-efu 21000 won, nke karịrị mmefu ego.
l-m-m2-b04-08.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ 20000 won, ma ihe ọṅụṅụ erughị 3.
l-m-m2-b04-08.s.s1.r.d: Ọ ga-ekwe omume na 19000 won, ma ị zụtara ihe ole na ole, naanị 11.
l-m-m2-b04-08.s.s1.explain: 9×1500+3×2000=19500 won, zụtara ihe 12. Atụmatụ ndị ọzọ na-emebi ọnọdụ ma ọ bụ zụta ole na ole.
l-m-m2-b04-08.s.s2.model.0: Ọ na-efu 19500 won, n'ime mmefu ego, nwere ihe ọṅụṅụ 3, ya mere atụmatụ a nke ihe 12 dabara kacha.
l-m-m2-b04-08.s.s2.model.1: Zụta naanị ihe ọṅụṅụ 3, nke kacha nta e kwere, jiri ego fọdụrụ zụta snacks dị ọnụ ala, ya mere ihe 12 bụ nke kacha.

l-m-m2-b04-16.title: Ogologo oge ole ka mmiri dị n'ime tank ga-ezuru?
l-m-m2-b04-16.topic: Oge iji mmiri dị n'ime tank
l-m-m2-b04-16.goal: Mgbe ị na-eji mmiri dị n'ime tank, tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m2-b04-16.material: Ọ bụrụ na ị mepee mmiri n'ime tank 100 L, mmiri fọdụrụ mgbe nkeji x gasịrị bụ y=100−4x (L). A ga-ahapụ opekata mpe 40 L mmiri, ma ịchọrọ iji ya ruo ogologo oge kacha ukwuu.
l-m-m2-b04-16.s.s1.prompt: Kedu oge iji ya kacha dabara adaba nke na-emezu ọnọdụ abụọ ahụ?
l-m-m2-b04-16.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-arụ ọrụ ma 60 L fọdụrụ, ma ị nwere ike iji ya ogologo oge karịa.
l-m-m2-b04-16.s.s1.r.b: 28 L fọdụrụ, nke na-erughị 40 L achọrọ.
l-m-m2-b04-16.s.s1.r.c: 20 L fọdụrụ, nke na-erughị 40 L achọrọ.
l-m-m2-b04-16.s.s1.explain: Site na 100−4x≥40, x≤15. Mgbe nkeji 15 gachara, kpọmkwem 40 L fọdụrụ.
l-m-m2-b04-16.s.s2.model.0: 100−4x≥40, ya mere x≤15, oge kacha ogologo iji ya bụ nkeji 15.
l-m-m2-b04-16.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe nkeji 15 gasịrị, 40 L fọdụrụ, ya mere ọ bụ oge kacha ogologo na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ.

l-m-m2-b0s5-04.title: Njem ole ka achọrọ n'ime oke elevator?
l-m-m2-b0s5-04.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha n'atụmatụ ibugharị ibu n'ime oke, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m2-b0s5-04.material: Onye na-elekọta ụlọ akwụkwọ dị 65 kg na-ebugharị igbe akwụkwọ 22, 12 kg nke ọ bụla, site na elevator. Onye na-elekọta ya na-arị njem ọ bụla, elevator nwere ike ibu mmadụ na ngwongwo ọnụ ruo 200 kg. Ị chọrọ njem kacha nta.
l-m-m2-b0s5-04.s.s1.prompt: Atụmatụ nke na-edobe oke ma nwee njem kacha nta bụ nke a?
l-m-m2-b0s5-04.s.s1.r.b: Njem igbe 12 bụ 65+144=209 kg, karịrị oke.
l-m-m2-b0s5-04.s.s1.r.c: Ọ dị n'ime oke, ma enwere ike ime ya na njem abụọ, ya mere nke a dị ọtụtụ.
l-m-m2-b0s5-04.s.s1.o.d: Kewaa njem abụọ nke 11 nke ọ bụla
l-m-m2-b0s5-04.s.s1.explain: 65+12×11=197 kg, erughị ma ọ bụ hà 200 kg, ma igbe 12 ga-abụ 209 kg. Enwere ike ibugharị igbe 22 n'ime njem abụọ nke 11.
l-m-m2-b0s5-04.s.s2.model.0: Ruo igbe 11 n'otu oge bụ 197 kg, na-arụ ọrụ, igbe 12 bụ 209 kg karịrị, ya mere njem abụọ nke 11 kacha nta.
l-m-m2-b0s5-04.s.s2.model.1: Ka ọ dị n'ime oke, njem ọ bụla ga-ebu 11 ma ọ bụ obere, 22 nwere ike ime njem abụọ nke 11, ya mere nke a ka njem atọ mma.
